skill: Signposting a presentation and handling questions

words.es: aprender a moverse por algo / orientarse
words.def: to learn how to use something and move through it without getting confused
words.ex: It took me a few days to {find my way around} the new app, but now I love it.
The new design is much more {user-friendly}.

words.es: echar un vistazo rápido / pasar rápido
words.def: to move quickly through content, looking at things briefly
words.ex: I was just {flicking through} my feed when I came across that article.

words.def: a specific thing an app or device is designed to do
words.ex: The search {function} is really handy: it finds anything in seconds.
The app {crashed} just as I was about to pay.

words.def: always working the way you expect, without letting you down
words.ex: I switched to a more {dependable} app after the old one kept crashing.

words.def: a window that appears suddenly on screen
words.ex: A {pop-up} appeared asking me to subscribe.

words.def: to install the latest version of an app
words.ex: I always {update} my apps on Sunday evening.
